levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن المبارك المخرمي

notes: Two taḥwīl branches («ح») meet at الأعمش; the names after the meeting («عن أبي صالح، عن أبي هريرة») are written once, so they form the shared tail for both groups.
Branch 2 repeats its own Abu Mu'awiya and Amash, which is why its levels are written in full; the first branch stops at الأعمش before «ح».
